create_MeanFieldPSRO: create a MeanFieldPSRO instance with a game, regret minimizer, and regret steps per step
run_MeanFieldPSRO_step: run a single PSRO step that computes best response and minimizes regret
get_MeanFieldPSRO_equilibrium: get the equilibrium policies, nus, mus, and weights from a trained MeanFieldPSRO
filter_new_policies: filter new best-response policies to keep only novel ones not equal to existing policies
equal_policies_check: check if two greedy policies produce equal action distributions across all states
